series_key: universal regression model for market price prediction
mechanism: Three Gamma-distribution modifications—past P (integral of C with n+1), current C (differential density), future F=1−(P+C)—satisfy P+C+F=1 at every t. Parameters: n (control), tau/T (time constant), D (system potential/max price-change amplitude). Maps destabilized price/equity path into a normalized past–present–future regime.
data_needed: incomplete Euler Gamma forms for P,C,F; fitted n, tau, D on price or equity series; retrospective depth (e.g. 300 D1 bars)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 33 FX pairs + gold/silver basket on D1; cent account experiment; MT4/MT5 Sultonov indicators
why_new_for_mis: Normalized PCF Gamma chain is a portable three-phase transient regime model for price/equity, distinct from MA/volatility bands.
quote: there are three stages of dynamic transients defined in the form of various modifications of the Gamma distribution function that determine the behavior of a studied parameter. In particular, the dependence of the market price on time in the past (P), current time (C) and future (F).

series_key: universal regression model for market price prediction
mechanism: Indicator draws Sell (red), Buy (blue), trader (yellow) PCF lines. Graph bifurcation = unstable market; after trend forms lines combine on target. Yellow line jumping from one line to another signals possible trend change at formation stage; single opposite-color arrow among many marks prior-bar trend replacement without locking future bars.

series_key: using the mql5 economic calendar for news filter
mechanism: During an active economic-calendar news window, SuspendStops(true) strips SL/TP from open positions (saved ticket/sl/tp), then SuspendStops(false) restores them when the window ends—treating the news interval as a high-volatility risk regime where broker stops are temporarily unsafe. Part 3 persists that suspension via terminal GlobalVariables so restarts mid-window do not strand unprotected trades.
data_needed: news window detection (Parts 1–2); savedStops[]; GlobalVariableSet/Get/Del Harbinger_Stop_* and Harbinger_NewsSuspended; PositionModify
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: open positions on chart symbol; NewsMinutesBefore/After window (test used 15m); calendar-driven
why_new_for_mis: News-window-as-stop-suspension regime is an actionable vol-protection sensor; persistence makes the regime recoverable across terminal death.
quote: We already have a news filter that temporarily removes SL/TP and restores them after a news window ... If a restart or recompile occurs between SuspendStops(true) and SuspendStops(false), that in-memory state is lost.
